newsitem.title: USA: MGIC Investment expects strong second half.
newsitem.headline: MGIC Investment expects strong second half.

text.p: MGIC Investment Corp said Monday it expects new insurance written during the second half of the year to exceed the amount written during the first six months.
Earlier MGIC Investment reported record earnings of $80.6 million or $0.67 a share for the second quarter compared to $62.7 million or $0.53 in the same period last year.

"The outlook for the balance of the year continues to be very positive," said MGIC president and chief executive William Lacy. "We expect new insurance written for the balance of the year to exceed the amount written in the first half, and credit quality should continue to be excellent."

As of June 30, 1997, Mortgage Guaranty Insurance Corp's primary insurance in force was $134.2 billion, up $2.8 billion from December 31, 1996, and $9.2 billion from June 30, 1996, the company said. Mortgage Guaranty Insurance is a subsidiary of MGIC Investment Corp, which provides private mortgage insurance coverage for homeowners.
The book value of MGIC Investment Corp's investment portfolio increased $120 million from December 31, 1996, to $2.2 billion at June 30, 1997, and was up $367 million from June 30, 1996.
The company said its results for the second quarter were led by a 16 percent increase in revenues. Losses incurred and expenses increased one percent.
